samples.question: The picture contains exactly one thin dark outline. That outline is a single closed loop: it never branches and never crosses itself, so it can be walked like a circular track. Exactly four small filled circles (red, green, blue, amber) sit on the loop; the loop passes through each of them. Walking around the loop visits the four circles in a cyclic order. Straight-line nearness in the picture is not relevant: two circles can look close yet be far apart along the loop. Starting at the red circle and walking along the loop, the second circle you meet is the same one in both directions. Which colour is that second circle? Answer with one of: green, blue, amber.
